Learning Unit 8: Human Anatomy for the Operator

Learning outcome: Use anatomical position, movement, pattern and texture to explain normal structures and assess unexplained features.

Welcome to Learning Unit 8. Begin with why anatomy matters, follow the digestive route, recognise normal lookalikes, and apply the anatomy decision checklist. You are learning to interpret a security image, not to diagnose disease. Enlarge the pictures whenever you need more detail. Play or stop narration as you choose. Each activity is followed by its original knowledge check.
